title: Koko-en — official admissions, access needs and garden rules

facts.fact: The current operator offers separate garden and castle/garden combination admission; regular hours and annual December closures are listed and event times may differ.
A wheelchair route is available; some paths have slopes and the operator recommends an attendant.
Garden rules require staying on paths and prohibit entering grass or moss areas, feeding fish, and drones; professional and wedding portraits need advance permission.
